population.span: we randomly assigned patients who had myocardial infarction

endpoint.span: The primary efficacy outcome was a composite of death from cardiovascular causes, recurrent myocardial infarction, stroke, or unplanned ischemia-driven coronary revascularization, evaluated in a time-to-event analysis.

treatment_strategy.span: In this multicenter trial with a 2-by-2 factorial design, we randomly assigned patients who had myocardial infarction to receive either colchicine or placebo and either spironolactone or placebo.

follow_up.span: over a median follow-up period of 3 years

absent_reason: analysis_set: No held source explicitly states the analysis population used for the reported hazard ratio; intention-to-treat cannot be inferred from randomized totals.
served_mismatch: The served HR and confidence interval match the reported primary composite. The served intention-to-treat analysis-set label is not explicitly supported by any held source.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Randomized patients had myocardial infarction; registry eligibility excludes age ≤18 years, supporting an adult entry population. ITT status remains unstated.
